__comment: Manual psychoactive_class tagging pass (2026-07-23) for linked articles left untagged by the identification backfill. Every tag string is copied verbatim from existing peer articles; peer basis recorded per slug in provenance. Applied with scripts/convex/backfill-identification.mjs (fill-only-empty).

provenance.fentanyl-analogues: butyrfentanyl, 4-fluorobutyrfentanyl, 4-meo-butyrfentanyl, methoxyacetyl-fentanyl, parafluorofentanyl, valerylfentanyl: match fentanyl exactly.
provenance.clonazolam: matches triazolam (triazolobenzodiazepine peer set, also used by flubromazolam minus GABAergic).
provenance.meclonazepam: matches clonazepam (its direct parent compound) including Anticonvulsant.
provenance.phenidates-and-stimulants: ethylphenidate, dexmethylphenidate, 4-methylmethylphenidate match methylphenidate; a-pvp matches a-php/naphyrone; thiopropamine matches methiopropamine; 2-aminoindane tagged Stimulant only (MDAI's Entactogen reflects MDAI specifically; 2-AI is primarily stimulant).
provenance.bk-2c-b: Psychedelic/Hallucinogen per 2c-b minus Entactogen (mild); cathinone-peer consensus rejected as a mistag.
provenance.tryptamines: 4-aco-met matches 4-aco-dmt and 4-ho-met; 4-ho-mipt matches the 4-substituted tryptamine peer set (Psychedelic).
provenance.ghb: Depressant/Sedative per pharmacology; GABAergic per phenibut precedent (GABA-B agonism).
provenance.promethazine: Sedative + Depressant (mild) per hydroxyzine precedent, promoted to full Sedative for potency; chemical_class reuses existing 'Phenothiazine antihistamine' tag.
provenance.sertraline: Antidepressant per moclobemide/trazodone precedent; no sedative claim. chemical_class left empty — no established tag fits (closest existing tag 'Naphthalene derivative' felt like a stretch; flag for editorial).
provenance.theanine: Anxiolytic + Nootropic per bromantane precedent pattern; chemical_class reuses existing 'Amino acid' tag.
